question: What is the total revenue across all order items?
answer_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items
buggy_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items

question: How many customers are there?
answer_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers

question: How many orders have been placed?
answer_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders

question: How many orders have the status 'completed'?
answer_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: What is the total revenue from completed orders only?
answer_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
buggy_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id

question: Which product category has the highest total revenue?
answer_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
buggy_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many products are in the catalog?
answer_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products

question: How many customers are there in each country?
answer_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY n DESC, country

question: What is the average order value (total revenue per order)?
answer_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t

question: How many orders were cancelled?
answer_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the total revenue from orders placed in 2026 or later?
answer_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'

question: What is the total revenue from products in the Computers category?
answer_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Computers'
buggy_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Computer'

question: Which product has sold the most units?
answer_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units DESC, p.name LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
answer_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t
